event_detail: Drawer under the counter at the left corner: late in the episode (52.8-57.6 s) the gripper keeps hovering around the drawer front and handle with open, empty fingers, without pulling the drawer out or picking anything.
evidence: In the left shoulder view the gripper stays at the top drawer below the counter in all 4 moments; the drawer front looks flush (at most slightly ajar), and no drawer interior or straw is clearly visible. The wrist view shows the cabinet panel, the floor and a black drawer handle with the fingers open and empty; a thin light line near a finger at 56.0-57.6 s is too small to identify as the straw. The glass cup is never approached. The drawer state is hard to judge from these angles.
